summary: This note describes the role of ASTM International standards in questioned document examination (FDE). It states that ASTM publishes standards for many methods used by FDEs and that Subcommittee E30.02 on Questioned Documents, under ASTM Committee E30 on Forensic Sciences, held responsibility for the related guides. It also notes that the ASTM Questioned Document Section has since been disbanded.
one_line: ASTM standards and the former E30.02 Subcommittee on Questioned Documents that governed forensic document examination methods.
key_facts: The American Society for Testing and Materials, International (ASTM) publishes standards for many methods and procedures used by FDEs.
ASTM E30.02 was the ASTM subcommittee for Questioned Documents.
The guides for questioned document examination were under the jurisdiction of ASTM Committee E30 on Forensic Sciences.
The guides were under the direct responsibility of Subcommittee E30.02 on Questioned Documents.
The ASTM Questioned Document Section has been disbanded.
